title: clidemia petiolaris
intro: Clidemia petiolaris, commonly known as the mountain fire or red bush, is a species of flowering plant in the family Melastomataceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic properties include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been identified through various studies.
